findings.title: New raw census equality assertions can expose the private input through pytest --tb=line
findings.detail: The new failure cases compare complete JSONB row dictionaries directly in pytest assert operands. Rows retain the input sentinel created by the real setup. If a census comparison fails, assertion rewriting formats the actual values after private_channels has been skipped or has already returned; the sanitized P2_PROTOCOL_FAILURE line does not sanitize pytest's independent failure report. In the poison path, the last raw equality also runs after private_channels. Thus a test can correctly fail while emitting the very private input its oracle promises not to expose.

reproducer.result: Expected failing assertion; pytest exit 1 and SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE_I1 present in captured line-report bytes.

findings.title: The new private_channels guard accepts capability/DSN-bearing diagnostics
findings.detail: The checker searches only SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE_I1 and SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE_ACK_ERROR. The actual runtime capability and database URL are not checked. A diagnostic containing the known test capability or a DSN/password without either of those two markers is accepted. This is an evidence gap in the test oracle, not an observed production leak.

reproducer.method: AST-load the exact private_channels function from the reviewed file with its closure seams. Supply logs.text containing the peer's synthetic capability shape and a separate synthetic password-bearing DSN. It returns normally. No DB credentials are loaded.
reproducer.positive_negative_controls: The same actual function accepts empty output and rejects each of its two intended marker strings with the constant sanitized AssertionError.
reproducer.result: Blind-spot and ordinary-marker control tests both pass, confirming the unwanted acceptance and the checker's intended-marker sensitivity.

criterion_disposition.criterion: EOF/timeout/cancel/invalid ACK after real write -> SENT/UNKNOWN, no refund/resend
criterion_disposition.evidence: PG write observer reads committed SENT on an independent connection before delegating actual writer.write; peer reads exact frame. Cancel is issued only after received and targets the real owner handler. Four fault orders use the existing peer failure producer, not an injected UNKNOWN context. Six-kind ledger oracle rejects settlement/refund extras, binds command/descriptor/dispatch; charged output stays 64 in fresh readback. SOURCE focused faults pass.

criterion_disposition.criterion: Late Stop commits before T2 accounting; no new grant/send/wake/duplicate writes
criterion_disposition.evidence: late_settle delegates real T2 only after observed settle entry and completed service.shutdown. It reads committed incremented generation, admission_open=false, command ID and unchanged managed rows before release. Full settlement/replay/fresh readback and exact authority/reserve/wire counters constrain receive-only behavior. The setup remains a synthetic native identity seed, explicitly not native execution.

Separate parametrized fixture context is never protocol-launched; six finite controls use actual control_task. The context/qualified configuration/decision are real producers. Each joined command compares census and requires zero reserve/wire/observations. Ref conflict is COMMAND_CONFLICT; other internal refusals normalize to TASK_REJECTED on this public channel. Heartbeats occur before each comparison, not silently within a no-write interval.

criterion_disposition.criterion: Untrusted extra receipt stored and rejected through same public receive-only consumer
criterion_disposition.evidence: late_stop stores a separately identified, explicitly untrusted duplicate envelope via managed_store after authentic settlement. Duplicate count refuses in model_protocol.readback before any forged receipt can be accepted. This case proves duplicate/extra receipt refusal, not that the extra-field validator itself was reached; existing SOURCE extra-field controls remain separately scoped.

PG new cancel checks actual owner cancellation after peer read, sanitized public EOF classification, retired runtime, conservative durable ledger and no resend. New finalizer releases the T2 barrier, cancels/joins test-owned sender tasks; existing LocalControl and peer context finalizers handle their actual owner/client task cleanup.
